Commentary.Commentary: This should be a relatively straightforward chase for the Indians. Their form in this series so far has no reason to suggest otherwise. However, there is the thing with the wicket slowing down in the second half. The Black Caps do have an extra spinner in the side for that very reason, so if the spin attack gets going, something could happen. Let's see how it unfolds in the run chase.

Everyone chipped in with the wickets, barring Kuldeep and Jadhav, who despite that, remained economical. The start was good, the middle overs saw the runs being choked and except for that phase where Taylor and Latham were striding along, everything was in complete control. Shami led the charge with a 3-fer, while Bhuvneshwar, Chahal and Pandya bagged 2 apiece. The all-rounder did well in his comeback game, having played his last one in September 2018 against Pakistan in the Asia Cup.

New Zealand may have their highest score of this series, but it still might not be enough. It's been another good show by India with the ball, especially after being asked to bowl. Rocked the top order early and were right on top. But, Taylor and Latham took things in their side and added 119 runs between them, with the former missing out on a ton and the latter stroking a fifty. Nothing before and nothing after came after them. It was a rather toothless batting display once more.

OUT! NEW ZEALAND HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 243! A slower length delivery outside the line of off stump, Trent Boult backs away and throws everything at it. Gets a fat top edge which balloons towards short third man. Shami comes under it and takes it.
Pulls this short ball away into the leg side for one.
Moves across his sticks and punches it down to long on for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
In the air but safe. Shortish ball, outside off, Boult swings and gets a top edge in the vacant short third man region. A single is taken.
Lockie Ferguson is the new man in.

OUT! Bracewell is run out. Quick wickets for India. Will New Zealand even last the full 50 overs? Boult pushes this towards short mid-wicket and Bracewell takes off, when there's no run to be had. Kohli gets to the ball quickly, runs to the stumps and takes the bails off. Easily done.
Trent Boult out now.
OUT! Makes amends this time. Cost his side just two runs more. Shami bowls it fuller and slower around off, Sodhi slogs it straight down Kohli's throat at long on. He takes it safely this time.
The batsman has done well to keep that yorker at bay.

Dropped! By Virat Kohli of all people. You don't see that every day. Fuller and slower on the stumps, Sodhi is early into the shot and ends up chipping it high towards long on. The Indian skipper settles under it, but spills it. Two runs taken.
SIX! That's gone many a miles! Finally connects with one. Short of a length in line of the stumps, Ish Sodhi camps back and muscles the heave over mid-wicket for a maximum.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Full toss on off stump, hit to off stump. The batsmen take off, there is a shy at the bowler's end but it misses.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven through mid on for a run.
Flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a single for doing so.
Wide! Completely misses that! Slower short ball, Sodhi sticks back, waits for it and tries to ramp it over, but misses. Wide called though.
Yorker fired in on middle and leg, Doug digs it out through mid-wicket and changes ends.
Sodhi opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full delivery hurled outside off, slower in pace, Sodhi looks to go big downtown but misses.
Short of a good length on the fourth stump line, Sodhi moves across, gets behind the line and plays it back to the bowler.
This ball on a fuller length is driven towards mid on. A single has been collected.
Short ball, Sodhi plays and misses.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full outside off, driven to the man at cover.
Too straight in line, worked fine down the leg side for a single.
Ish Sodhi to bat next.

OUT! The bat has hit the pad and there is an outside edge too! No century for Ross Taylor. How disappointing, but a terrific knock nonetheless, once again. He's stood tall when his team's been under the pump. Length delivery around off, some slight movement away, Taylor looks to run it down but gets an edge behind. Karthik takes it and India celebrate. Rosco, however, takes the DRS as he thinks he hasn't edged it, from the looks of it. And that it's gone off the pad? Anyway, replays roll in and show there is a definite edge.
Review. For what exactly? Taylor has gone upstairs after having a chat with his partner. Maybe he thinks the bat hit his pad? I'm not sure, but let's see now...
Plays it late. Waits for it to come, the length ball outside off, and steers it to third man for one run. That's Pandya done for the innings, he finishes with figures of 10-0-45-2.
Slower one again, a length ball around off, Bracewell drags the swipe through square leg and brings Taylor on strike.
Outside off, going on straight, guided down to third man for a run.
Fraction straight in line, worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Top edge and over the keeper's head. Taylor moves into the 90s in a streaky manner. Slower one around off, the batsman looks to slog but it goes off the edge and across the fine leg fence for a boundary.

Was loading up for the big one, Ross Taylor. Pulled out at the last second. Moved across to the full ball outside off, but Pandya took the pace off it. Seeing this, Rosco adjusted and dug it out. Well done on both ends.
Wide! Fuller and down the leg side, Ross looks to flick but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
Hardik Pandya comes back on. He will bowl out.
Full ball on off, driven through to long on for a single.
Short ball on middle and off, pulled through the vacant square leg region for a run.
Shaping away from a good length, around off, Rosco stabs it square towards point and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Poor line and he's paid the price for it. Angling down, Taylor flicks it down to fine leg. Nobody out there, so a boundary results.
Full ball just outside off, Bracewell drives it to mid off and takes off. Pandya there collects and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Bracewell is well in though and replays confirm that.
Aims the top of off stump with a length ball, Doug defends it with the full face of the bat.
Mohammed Shami is back on to bowl.
Runs it down to third man for a single. End of a decent over from Kumar.
Waits for the ball to come to him and pats it down in front of point.
Hangs on the back foot and keeps it out on the off side.

FOUR! It's a boundary but a fine effort from Dhawan in the deep. Was too far away from him, but a fine effort nonetheless. Bracewell lofts it from his crease over cover-point. Shikhar in the deep flies to his left but can't get to it.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, dabbed to point.
Beaten! Peach from Bhuvi. Lands it around off, it comes in at first but then straightens up at the last moment. Bracewell is squared up as he tries to defend. Almost edges it behind.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Spills it on the pads, Bracewell flicks it fine down the leg side. A couple of runs are taken and the 200 comes up for New Zealand.
Hardik brings out the short one, pounds it in on middle, Bracewell ducks and evades.
Doug Bracewell walks in next.

OUT! Pandya picks up his second of the innings. New Zealand lose another wicket and slip further. Sloppy dismissal, really. It's hurled wide outside off, Santner throws his bat at it. Nothing wrong with it, but that's a ball he should be hitting. Gets an edge behind and Karthik does the rest.
Full and wide outside off, Santner reaches out and drills it through the covers. Big gap out there, so the batsmen come back for the second.
Wide! Slower delivery down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Length delivery just outside off, it's chopped down to third man for a single.
Around middle, pushed towards mid on.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Landed outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around off, Santner looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.

Landed outside off, Taylor looks to chop it towards third man and run but is not so sure. Santner is sure though and calls him through. Karthik fires a throw at the bowler's end but Taylor makes it. The throw misses the stumps anyways.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end.
A short ball, around middle, Santner lets it through. 4 runs and a wicket from the over, Pandya's figures read 8-0-30-1.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Mitchell Santner walks in at number 7, replacing Nicholls.

OUT! Gloved behind! Nicholls was safe on the previous ball but he is gone now. The short ball, down the leg side, Henry looked to pull but was cramped for room. Only managed to glove it behind. Easy catch for Karthik. Couple of quick wickets for India.

FOUR RUNNING RUNS! Outside off, Nicholls punches it through the covers. The ball races towards the boundary but Shikhar Dhawan puts in a desperate dive to his left from sweeper cover. Manages to stop the ball and returns a throw to the bowler. By this time, the batsmen run the fourth. Hardik collects and fires a throw at the striker's end and they refer it upstairs but replays show that Nicholls is fine.
A short ball, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
Hardik Pandya is back on. 7-0-26-0 so far.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Taylor cuts it hard but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns. 5-1-23-1 so far.

SAFE! By the thinnest of margins. Full and outside off, Taylor pushes it towards cover. He sets off for a quick single but Rohit Sharma charges in and has an under-arm shy at the striker's end. He is confident that he has his man but replays show that Nicholls is in.
DIRECT HIT! Is Nicholls gone? Rohit certainly thinks he has his man. Let's see what the third umpire sees.
On middle and leg, worked wide of long on for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Henry Nicholls walks in at number 6, replacing Latham.

OUT! Holes out in the deep! India get the breakthrough at last. The 119-run stand is broken. A similar shot to how Latham has been playing so far. Coming down the track and taking the ball on the full. One occasion, he got a biggie. This time though, the timing is not quite there. Simple catch for Ambati Rayudu at deep mid-wicket. The moment Latham connected his flick, he knew and admonished himself. A platform has been set though.
Down the leg side, worked towards square leg.
FIFTY FOR LATHAM NOW! His 13th in ODIs, 4th vs India. Comes down the track again, converts the flighted ball into a full toss again. Works it through mid-wicket for a couple. Can he bat through?
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Another googly, this time Rosco does not pick it and is beaten as he looks to defend.
FOUR! Nice-looking shot. The googly, outside off, Taylor drives this through the covers and gets a boundary!
Comes down the track again and eases it towards long on for a single.
Comes down the track and blocks it out.
Full and around middle, worked towards square leg.
Drives this through the covers for a couple. 11 from the over.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
SIX! That is an outstanding shot. Chahal tosses this up on middle but Latham is straightaway down the track. Converts it into a low full toss and whips it over square leg for a biggie!
Outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Full and down the leg side, swept fine for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Latham looks to sweep but under-edges it to short fine leg. A run taken.
Outside off, played straight to short third man.
Around off, watchfully defended.
100-RUN STAND IS UP! The fightback continues. Around middle and leg, Taylor gently works it to the leg side and scrambles through.
Outside off, eased wide of long off for a run.
Full on middle, pushed through the off side for a single.
Outside off, punched through point for one more.
Outside off, eased behind point again, this time for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Played very fine. Landed outside off, Taylor cuts that very late and beats short third man.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back on. 6-0-27-1 so far.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

YES-NO, YES-NO, SAFE! Very lucky, is Ross Taylor. He works it towards square leg and sets off for a single. But Latham is not that sure. Virat Kohli charges across from short mid-wicket, gets to the ball and shys at the keeper's end but it is wide. Karthik had to stretch. Even if he had got a straight throw, Rosco would have been gone.
Full and around off, pushed to the off side.
A low full toss, dipping into the batsman, Latham flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around middle, Taylor looks to defend but the ball spins in and goes off the inner half through square leg. A single taken.
Down the leg side, Rosco misses his flick and is hit on the pads. A leg bye taken. 10 from the over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

FOUR! 46TH ODI FIFTY FOR TAYLOR, 6TH VS INDIA! Yet another half century for the of-late consistent batsman. His 7th 50-plus score in last 9 knocks. Short and outside off, Taylor cuts it behind point and gets consecutive boundaries!
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short and outside off, Taylor rocks back and cuts it through the covers for a boundary! The stand moves to 80 from 90 balls.
Down the leg side, swept fine for a single.
Extremely full, on middle and leg, almost a yorker, the southpaw works it through mid-wicket. A run is collected.
Eases this full ball down to long off for a single.
Landed on a driving length, Tom kneels down and sweeps it through square leg before getting to the other end.
Loopy and full around off, Latham prods forward and defends.
Full on middle and leg, turning down, Taylor goes back and works it fine down the leg side. The fielder chases it down, slides and keeps it inside the rope. Three runs taken. Good effort.
Tossed up on middle and leg, swept behind square on the leg side for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav returns. 4-0-19-0 so far.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Around middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
7th ball of the over? According to us, 6 balls have been done and dusted legally. However, the umpire believes there is one left. Bizarre.

NOT OUT! UMPIRE'S CALL ON HEIGHT! Lucky escape for Taylor. On a length, around off, Taylor looks to work it to the leg side but misses. Pandya appeals but the umpire stays put. Hardik is busy discussing with his captain regarding the review but in the meanwhile, Latham has charged down halfway for the single. He is sent back and one of the Indian fielders notices that. Has a shy at the bowler's end and scores a direct hit. The run out is checked but replays show that Latham is home. A run was taken in the end off the deflection.
LBW? Hardik reckons he has Taylor right in front. India take a review. Looks plumb. There is a run out appeal as well. One of the Indian fielders says, 'ARRE, DONO OUT HAI!'
Down the leg side, worked to the leg side as well, for another single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for one.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
Landed outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Around off, solidly defended.
Karthik is frustrated. Because Taylor has just pushed it towards cover and stolen a single. 'AREY YAAR!' he yells.
Outside off, punched through point for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Eases this through mid on for a run.
Outside off, punched through mid off for a single.
Kedar Jadhav time. The man with the golden arm.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a run. 12 from the over!

FOUR! CLUNK! 50-RUN STAND UP IN 63 BALLS! Good recovery from the Kiwis. Probably now, Taylor has decided to put the foot down. A long hop, outside off, Rosco pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a couple.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Cheekily done. On a length outside off, Taylor opens the bat-face late and dabs it very fine. Kuldeep Yadav is stationed there but cannot get there!
WIDE. A wild bouncer outside off, Taylor looks to pull but then bails out.
Hardik Pandya is back on. 5-0-9-0 so far.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, tickled fine for a couple again. 100 UP FOR NEW ZEALAND.
Another misfield. Kedar Jadhav this time. A short ball, Latham pulls it towards short mid-wicket where Kedar Jadhav fumbles and allows a couple.

CHANCE OF A RUN OUT, MIX-UP, BUT SAFE! Ambati Rayudu is at it again. India have been deprived of a wicket. Short and outside off, Taylor cuts it towards backward point. He sets off for a single initially and seeing that, Latham responds. But then Rosco sees Rayudu attacking the ball and stops. Now, Latham is stranded. However, Ambati fumbles and that allows the batsmen to complete the single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Landed outside off, turning away, punched towards long on for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed wide of mid off for a run.
Landed outside off, pushed straight to point.
Full on middle, RT pushes it towards mid on, takes Ambati Rayudu on, the fielder reacts well but when the time comes to pick the ball and throw, the first action itself is not completed.
A length ball outside off, 145 KPH, Rosco looks to cut but is comprehensively beaten by pace.
Another short ball, pulled down to long leg for a run.
Short and outside off, Taylor crashes it behind point but for just a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! FIRST BOUNDARY AFTER THE 12TH OVER. That is how good India have been. Full and around leg stump, Latham gets down and paddles it pretty fine. Ambati Rayudu gets across from fine leg, dives but is not able to stop it.
The googly, pushed through point for one.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.

BRUTE! Is this a Test match? Sharp short ball from Shami and Latham has nowhere to go. The delivery kicks off from leg stump and the southpaw just hangs his bat at it. It flies off the edge towards where short leg would have been, but this is not a Test, hence there is no short leg. A single taken.

LEADING EDGE, SAFE! Might say, Shami reacted late. But that is a really tough call. A length ball, around middle, Latham looked to tuck it to the leg side but got a leading edge. Shami was going to his left in his follow-through but the ball came to his right. He tried to change track but it is always difficult for a fast bowler to suddenly do so. Is not quite able to get to it.
WIDE. Way down the leg side, left alone.
A short ball, around off, Latham looks to pull but the ball goes off the inside edge and hits him on the pads.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Short and outside off, chopped down to third man for a single.
Mohammed Shami returns. Kohli going for the kill. 4-0-13-1 so far. One would have thought more of 'KULCHA' but this is good captaincy. Not letting the opposition set into a plan.
Full and around off, tossed up slightly, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, spinning way, punched straight to cover.
Full and outside off, eased down to long off for one.
This is on the stumps, the paddle comes out again. Much finer but just a run. The stand moves to 20 from 31 balls.
A pre-meditated paddle but controls it well, with Kuldeep slowing that very much and bowling it wide outside off. A couple to fine leg.
Full and around middle, Taylor gets down and paddles it fine for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav returns to the attack.
Goes with the spin as he turns this through the vacant square leg region. A couple of runs collected.
The leg break outside off, the right-hander drives through the line and places it through covers. The batsmen cross over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Plays this with soft hands. Taylor works it down on the leg side.
Turning in on leg stump, worked down to fine leg for one more.
Doesn't turn as much, going on straight mostly, on middle and leg, Ross goes on the back foot and nudges it through mid-wicket. One run to the total.
Goes full, just outside off, Taylor drives it to mid off from the middle of the bat.
Fraction straight in line, worked behind square leg for a single.
A little fuller in length, outside off, it's played back to the bowler.
Angles it in on leg, it goes off Taylor's pads and runs down towards fine leg past the diving keeper. The batsmen take two leg byes.
Short ball banged in, Taylor looks to pull but the bounce gets too big on him.
Beaten! Landed outside off on a length, Taylor looks to defend but the ball moves away late ever so much. It whiskers past the outside edge and goes into the keeper's gloves.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.

Top edged but safe! Just over leg gully. Loopy and full on leg, Latham gets low to sweep and gets it off the top edge. It goes over the fielder and behind. Kohli from short fine leg runs after it and while trying to collect the ball, slips. The ball is thrown back in by the other fielder but luckily, the Indian skipper isn't injured. Two taken.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Flights it up, around the off stump, Tom prods forward in defense.
Eases it down the ground to long on for one run.
Some drift inwards on middle and leg, Taylor works it towards mid-wicket with soft hands.
Makes it go across, on a good length, Latham plants his front foot forward and firmly blocks it just wide of cover.
Slightly ahead of a length, just around off, the left-hander plays it back down the track.
Makes it go away, around off, Latham hangs inside the crease and defends it on the off side.
Latham walks a step down and pats this back of a length ball in front of cover-point.
Angling across from a good length, outside off, left alone.

Short of a good length on off stump, Latham with a little swivel pulls it along the turf in front of square leg. Kedar Jadhav from deep square leg moves to his right and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Stays leg side, makes a little room and drives, only to find the man at extra cover.
Quite slow through the air again, on middle and off, Rosco positions himself well behind the line and defends.
Tossed up on off stump, blocked by coming well forward.
Loopy and full on leg stump, Latham flicks it off his pads through square leg and takes a single.
Tom Latham walks into the middle next.

OUT! What a catch from the returning Hardik Pandya! Incredible stuff. And it's the big fish Kane Williamson to depart. He was looking frustrated out there, and now his stay has come to an end. A lot of flight on leg stump, Williamson steps out and flicks it aerially towards mid-wicket. Pandya there dives full stretch to his left and takes a stunner. New Zealand in a real spot of bother, they've lost their talisman and skipper.
Quicker through the air and full outside off, Williamson crouches and squeezes it past Rohit at first slip diving to his right. Single taken.
Single. Dabs it behind point with an open bat face and jogs across to the other end. Just 1 run off the over, another tidy over from Hardik.
Full delivery sprayed on the pads, flicked straight to the man at mid-wicket, who's positioned at the edge of the ring. He'll feel he's missed out there.
Doesn't rise as much. A back of a length ball on off angling in, Williamson looks to heave it over mid-wicket but gets a bottom edge which goes behind to the keeper on a few bounces.
Give the charge on this occasion. Gets cramped for room and ends up mistiming the punch to the left of the bowler.
In line of the stumps this time, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Zipping off the surface, a good length ball just outside off. Kane Williamson stays inside his crease and defends.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Brings his wrists into play and works it to wide long on for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Williamson gives the charge, gets close to the pitch and wrists it to long on before crossing over.
Kane is forward again as he buries it into the track.
Quite slow through the air from the leggie, Williamson blocks it under his nose.
Change of ends for Yuzvendra Chahal as well.
Williamson goes the same way. Plays it late with an angled bat and guides it to third man. Single to the total.
Cutting in from a length, around off, run down to third man for one.
Swing and a miss! Taylor looks to take the pull on seeing it land a bit short. He rocks back, goes for the shot but it goes under his bat.
Attacks the stumps on this occasion, Ross has no problem guarding it out.

Back of a length delivery on off, Taylor pulls it off the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. Dhawan out in the deep runs to his left, collects the ball, turns and throws it blindly. It goes through the center of the pitch and to the other side. The batsmen steal another run. Two in total.
Fullish in length, in line of the stumps, defended with a straight bat.
Change of ends for Hardik Pandya.

Shout for a leg before, turned down. Floated on off, the googly, Williamson looks to defend but the spins away and catches him on the back pad. The appeal is shut down as it would have missed the off stump.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. They pick up a single.
Turning in from around off, Rosco goes deep inside the crease and turns it in front of square leg.
Works it away to mid-wicket for no run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Looped up around off, kept out from the front foot.
Kuldeep Yadav on to bowl now.
FOUR! That's terrific. A boundary off the last ball again from Williamson. Spinning away a bit on off, shorter in length, Kane goes back and whips it with the wrists through mid-wicket. Amazing shot.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.

What happened there? Lucky Ross Taylor. Got some bat on it, otherwise he was a goner. A lot of air from Chahal, quite full on leg. Taylor gets low to play the paddle sweep, but he seems to misjudge the flight. Fortunately for him, the ball takes the bottom edge and misses the leg stump.
Drives this with the spin and finds the man at covers.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, Kane works it towards wide long on for a single.
Tossed up leg break well outside off, driven through to deep point for one run.
Targets the top of off stump with a length ball, Williamson blocks with a straight blade in response. Good start from Pandya, just 1 run off his first over.
Brings his wrists into play and turns it to the man in front of square leg.
Good length ball very close to off, the batter defends from within his crease.
Pitched outside off on a good length, the NZ skipper dabs it square to the man at point.
Short of a good length on leg, Taylor works it off his hips behind square leg and gets to the other end.
Goes full straightaway, on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Powerplay 2 signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Hardik Pandya is introduced into the bowling attack.

FOUR! Absolute quality from Williamson. Finishes the over with a boundary. Chahal once again bowls it slower through the air and slightly shorter in length, Williamson goes with the spin and times the punch through covers to perfection. No stopping that one.
Nice shape on it. Looped up on off stump, slight spin away, it's pushed to long off for a run.
Spinning away from around off, shorter in length this time, Taylor backs away to cut but can't get it wide of point.
Chahal really slows this up, pitches it full on off, Taylor drives it into his hands along the ground.
Gives plenty of air on this, on off stump, driven back in the bowler's direction.
Tossed up delivery on middle and off, eased down to long off for a single.
Spin early in this game. Yuzvendra Chahal into the attack now. A slip in place for him.
Finds the gap well. Back of a length outside off, the Kiwi skipper glides it through point with an angled bat and retains strike with one.
Just around off, a length ball and it's patted down on the off side.
Ahead of a length, outside off, pushed defensively to covers.

FOUR! Shot. That's beautiful. Doesn't try to hit it hard at all. All about the timing. Full and straight from Bhuvneshwar, Williamson drives it back down the ground, past mid off and sends it across the boundary line.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Superb timing from Kane Williamson. He's a real joy to watch when he's on song, which is most of the time. He just stands tall and punches it on the up through the covers. Easily comes back for the second.
Keeps a touch low. Williamson tries to cut but chops it off the bottom edge behind point for a run.
Full delivery just outside off, driven right at the bowler. Dot ball.
Skids off the deck a bit, outside off on a length, Kane mistimes his punch towards the cover region.
On middle and off from Shami, pushes down the track, a little on the leg side.
In line of the stumps, Williamson positions himself perfectly behind the line and defends.

Direct hit but to no avail. Good running between the wickets. Taylor works this to mid-wicket and sets off. Pandya there moves to his left, collects the ball and hits the bull's eye at the bowler's end. Ross is well in by that time.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, Kane punches it on the up towards wide mid off.
Some inward movement from outside off, it's landed on a length, Rosco gets an edge down to third man and he gets off the mark with a single.
Marginally ahead of a length, on the fourth stump line, Taylor gets right behind the line and blocks it down the track.
Fullish in length, quite close to off, Taylor meets it with the full face of the bat.
Ross Taylor is the next batsman in.

OUT! Edged and gone! Now both the openers are back in the dressing room. India off to a fine start again with the ball. Bhuvneshwar throws it fuller and outside off, it's there to be hit and Guptill goes for it too, but the slight away movement maybe becomes his undoing. He gets a feather behind and Karthik completes the formalities.

Not out! Back of a length around off, Williamson punches it back from the back foot. Shami gets his fingertips on it, it hits the stumps at the bowler's end and the appeal is taken upstairs as Guptill stepped out for a moment. Replays show he came back inside in time.
A run out appeal is taken upstairs. Guptill is the man in question, but he seems to be safe.
Behind a good length, around off, the dab to third man is mistimed behind square on the off side.

FOUR! That's a fine shot. Williamson at his best. All class. It's on a back of a length outside off, Kane rises on his toes and with a vertical bat, crunches it through the gap in the covers to find the fence.
Seaming back into the batsman, a length delivery on off, the New Zealand skipper leans across and works it down gently on the leg side.
Outside off on a back of a length, Kane forces the punch wide of cover. Not wide enough though.
Cuts back in from a good length, catches Williamson on the pads as he tries to play at it. Too high though, so no appeal.
This length delivery is forced to mid off. End of a good over for New Zealand, 11 runs off it.

FOUR! Shot. Guptill looking in good rhythm here today. Full and too straight in line once again, the opener flicks it well over mid-wicket and gets a boundary this time. In complete control throughout.
Keeps it out on the off side comfortably.
Length ball outside off, it's played back to the bowler from inside the crease.

SIX! On the pads and Guptill goes big. Full on middle and leg, Guptill takes a step across and just drops it over mid-wicket. Has so much power behind it that the ball sails well over the fence for a biggie.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nicely done. Rising off the deck from a good length, Williamson opens the bat face, plays it late and places it behind point. Keeps strike with a single.
A touch short, outside off, the batsman dabs it to point. Can't get it wide of the fielder.
Serves it in the zone of apprehension, Kane remains cautious as he lets it through.
Leans ahead to this full length delivery and finds the mid off fielder with a drive.
On the fifth stump line, Williamson covers the line and watchfully lets it go.
Full ball attacking the stumps, Williamson brings down a straight blade in response.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. Maiden over from Bhuvi.
Forces this on the off side as Kumar bowls it around off. Not much room to work with.
On the fuller side of things once more, blocked with the full face.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Again on a length outside off, dabbed to point with an open face.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, left alone.

OUT! Gone this time! Munro survived a scare just a couple of balls ago, but pays the price this time. Can't make the most of the life given to him. Ahead of a length and outside off, Munro's eyes light up seeing the width. He looks to smash it through the covers but gets an edge to first slip where Rohit Sharma takes a straightforward catch. First breakthrough for India. Also, Kiwi skipper Kane Williamson walks in at no.3.
Served on middle, a length ball, shapes away late with some extra bounce. Guptill is squared up a bit and gets a thick edge down to third man for a run.

Dropped! But a difficult chance for Dinesh Karthik behind the stumps. Good length delivery around off, comes in a touch, Munro hangs his bat out to dry and gets a fat edge. It goes behind, DK dives low to his left but can't hold on. It goes behind and the batsmen take one.

FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets the desired result! The beauty of the Powerplay, clear the infield and find the fence. Back of a length around off, Munro's bat turns in his hands as he swings but it's enough to clear mid off.
Full ball on the off stump, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Shami comes from around the wicket and hurls it in the channel outside off, Munro goes for the expansive drive but misses.
Full delivery in line of the stumps, Munro pushes it just wide of mid off for a brisk run.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, on a good length, Guptill works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fraction straight in line, worked down on the leg side for a single. Munro opens his account as well.
Shaping away from a bit of a fuller length, around off, Munro wants to crash this through the off side but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Lands it on a good length which comes back in off the deck, Munro works it gently in front of mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball swinging back in, Guptill pushes it to mid on with a drive. A single taken and he's off the mark.
We are ready to begin. Colin Munro and Martin Guptill to start off, with Bhuvneshwar Kumar to take the first new ball. Here we go...

India captain, Virat Kohli, says they would have batted first as well as he feels the surface will get slower and slower as the game progresses. Mentions though he doesn't mind chasing as well. Wants to improve in the middle overs and personally wishes to up the scoring rate himself. Reckons that in the last game they should have got 340, but ended up with 325. Informs that there are two changes - MS Dhoni misses out with a sore hamstring and Dinesh Karthik comes in for him, and the other change is Hardik Pandya for Vijay Shankar. On Pandya, he adds that he brings great balance to the side as he's a great help with bat, ball and in the field too. On his wrist spinners, he reckons they played good cricket in England and Australia and that's largely down to Chahal and Kuldeep.

New Zealand captain, Kane Williamson, says it's a good surface which should play out well and slow down later on. Informs that there is one change as Mitchell Santner comes in for Colin de Grandhomme. States that given the surface, they wanted to play two spinners. Wants his players to bat longer and make full use of all the overs. Mentions that they want to focus on themselves and not worry about anything else. Ends by saying that it's imperative to create pressure with bat and ball and that's what they'll try to do today.
TOSS - New Zealand win the toss and elect to bat first!

Hello and welcome for the 3rd ODI between New Zealand and India. A must-win contest for the home side as the series is on the line. The Men in Blue have been clinical and ruthless in the opening two games, outplaying the Black Caps in all departments. Will want to continue in the same vein today and put in another professional display. New Zealand are yet to show any stomach to fight. Their over-reliance on Kane Williamson is letting them down and the others need to step up to the plate now. A lot rides on it. The toss and teams news to follow.
